concerns.text: T015 explicitly implements a 'compute but do not filter' logic to override spec FR-001(c). This is a semantic weakening of the functional requirement which mandates exclusion of features with |r| > 0.85. The task description admits to overriding the spec, which violates the constraint preservation principle unless the spec itself was formally amended to allow this override.

T031 implements VIF clustering but explicitly states 'DO NOT implement iterative feature removal'. This contradicts spec FR-007 which mandates 'iteratively removing the feature with the highest VIF if VIF > 5.0'. The task silently relaxes the requirement to a diagnostic-only step, violating the spec's functional constraint.

T033a implements 'SHAP-only resampling' (resampling computed values) instead of bootstrapping the dataset as required by spec FR-005 and SC-003. This semantic change invalidates the stability test because it does not verify feature set stability against data variation, only against statistical noise in the SHAP calculation, weakening the acceptance criterion.

T034a requires applying 'unsupervised clustering algorithms' to compute Jaccard similarity, whereas spec FR-007 and plan.md define the clustering logic as deterministic VIF-based grouping (|r| > 0.8). Introducing unspecified clustering algorithms violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle and the specific VIF constraint.

T016 implements a 'drop record' logic if >5% missing values exist. While FR-006 allows dropping records, T015's 'no filtering' constraint on features creates a conflict where the feature matrix composition is altered by record dropping, potentially violating the 'compute but do not filter' promise if the dropped records disproportionately affect specific features.
